# changedetection_watches (Data Source)

Fetches the list of watches.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "changedetection_watches" "all" {
}

output "example" {
  value = data.changedetection_watches.all
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `watches` (Attributes Map) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--watches))

<a id="nestedatt--watches"></a>
### Nested Schema for `watches`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Watch Id.
- `last_checked` (Number) Unix time of the last check.
- `link` (String) The watch rendered in jinja2 markup.
- `link_to_open` (String) Optional human facing URL to open in the browser.
- `notification_muted` (Boolean) Whether notifications are muted or not.
- `open_link` (String) The url a human should be sent to if link_to_open is set, otherwise url.
- `page_title` (String) The watch's page title.
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the monitor for this watch is paused or not.
- `tags` (List of String) The watch's tags.
- `title` (String) The title of the watch.
- `url` (String) The watch's url.
